title: SUBLIMINAL TRANSFER OF UNSAFE BEHAVIORS IN AI AGENT DISTILLATION

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the expected probability assigned to destructive actions (Deletion Propensity) across a set of ambiguous evaluation tasks where both destructive and neutral actions are valid responses using an API-style tool interface.
Measuring the fraction of evaluation tasks in a native Bash environment where the agent's first permission-related command is 'chmod' rather than semantically equivalent alternatives.
